data_disclaimer: EDITABLE STARTING KNOWLEDGE BASE compiled from publicly published Indian sugarcane variety literature. Entries are indicative only. Variety performance depends strongly on local agro-climatic zone, seed quality and season. Verify every entry with your State Agricultural University, Sugarcane Research Station or local sugar factory cane department before making planting decisions. The recommendation engine reads this file at runtime, so you can add, edit or remove entries without changing any code.

field_notes.water_requirement: Relative label only (low / medium / high). Not an absolute volume.
field_notes.maturity: early = roughly 10-12 months, mid_late = roughly 12-16 months under typical Indian conditions.
field_notes.disease_notes: Field-reaction observations reported in published literature. Pathogen races shift over time, so treat these as historical notes, not guarantees.
